<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Are You Single?|id=A0086}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
Liliana and JP teach us the basics of flirting — Latino style! Well, or maybe the girl is just practising Lojban... who knows? In any case, our keyword is: '''soltero''' — single (for “dudes”).
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0006|A0006: How's it going?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0011|A0011: Call me]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0127|A0127: Flirting]]}}
<noinclude>{{SbcAudioLojbanPod|title=Are you single?|id=A0086|dialogueid=A0086 dialogue}}</noinclude>

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¿Eres soltero?'''
| Are you single?
| '''Sí. ¿Y tú?'''
| Yes. How about you?
| '''No, tengo novio.'''
| No, I have a boyfriend.
| '''¡Qué lástima!'''
| What a pity!
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¿Eres soltero?'''
| Are you single?
| '''Sí. ¿Y tú?'''
| Yes. How about you?
| '''No, tengo novio.'''
| No, I have a boyfriend.
| '''¡Qué lástima!'''
| What a pity!
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| Are you single?
| '''¿Eres soltero?'''
| Yes. How about you?
| '''Sí. ¿Y tú?'''
| No, I have a boyfriend.
| '''No, tengo novio.'''
| What a pity!
| '''¡Qué lástima!'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Are you single?
| '''¿Eres soltero?'''
| Yes. How about you?
| '''Sí. ¿Y tú?'''
| No, I have a boyfriend.
| '''No, tengo novio.'''
| What a pity!
| '''¡Qué lástima!'''

<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Are you single? (masculine!)
| '''¿Eres soltero?'''
| No. I have a boyfriend.
| '''No, tengo novio.'''
|  What? — What a pity! 
| '''¿Qué? — ¡Qué lástima!'''
| And you? Are you single? (feminine)
| '''¿Y tú? ¿Eres soltera?'''
| Yes. 
| '''Sí.'''
| A pity...
| '''Lástima...'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Are you single? (masculine!)
| '''¿Eres soltero?'''
| No. I have a boyfriend.
| '''No, tengo novio.'''
|  What? — What a pity! 
| '''¿Qué? — ¡Qué lástima!'''
| And you? Are you single? (feminine)
| '''¿Y tú? ¿Eres soltera?'''
| Yes. 
| '''Sí.'''
| A pity...
| '''Lástima...'''
}}</includeonly>
